title: Luxembourg & Belgium
route: Strasbourg → Bourscheid Castle viewpoint → Liège-Guillemins → Emmen
introTitle: A castle viewpoint and a Belgian railway landmark.
intro: From the historic city of Strasbourg, the route crosses Luxembourg's wooded Sûre Valley near Bourscheid Castle, continues into Belgium at Liège's celebrated Guillemins railway station, and finishes in Emmen in the northeastern Netherlands.

stops.name: Strasbourg
stops.description: Historic Alsatian city on the Rhine, known for its cathedral, canals, and timber-framed architecture.

stops.name: Bourscheid Castle viewpoint
stops.description: A medieval hilltop fortress overlooking the wooded Sûre Valley in northern Luxembourg.

stops.name: Liège-Guillemins railway station (P9 parking)
stops.description: A landmark railway station designed by Santiago Calatrava, with a sweeping steel-and-glass canopy. P9 parking is on Rue de Sclessin.

stops.name: Emmen
stops.description: A city in the Dutch province of Drenthe, known for its green spaces and nearby prehistoric hunebed monuments.
